latest.headline: How the Machine Turns Fed Words Into Market Code
latest.summary: Christopher Waller changed words, not oil, not mortgage payments, not corporate refinancing bills and not household budgets. That was enough to change what machines could calculate. THE HUMAN HEARS A SPEECH. THE MACHINE HEARS FEATURES, WEIGHTS, PROBABILITIES AND DELTAS. The physical warning remained while the language produced a net relief signal that could travel through Treasury yields, futures, options and SPY before the economy itself changed.
